concepts.validActionSet: intersection of supported, advancing, and authorized actions
concepts.counterfactualIndependence: component independence tested by controlled variation
concepts.explicitAdmission: separate admission of successor facts after occurrence
concepts.progressiveDisclosure: low-friction interface that preserves inspectable responsibility
concepts.conservativeSessionLimit: lossless session-compatible projection for bounded low-complexity work
concepts.complexityBreakpoint: condition that makes an independent action responsibility decision-relevant and addressable
concepts.decisionObservationalEquivalence: componentwise preservation of direction, perspective boundary, effective authority, causal process, and admitted result
concepts.sessionRoundTripTheorem: conditional preservation theorem for session expansion and projection
concepts.contextInsufficiency: same-payload counterexample showing that context alone cannot determine the valid action set
concepts.domainProfile: versioned adopter declaration of how one domain inhabits the Fact-Episode Ontology and Action Responsibility Geometry
concepts.activationDecision: activate, revise, reject, or pending verdict
concepts.qualificationCut: exact evidence cut and independent review binding
concepts.profileRefinementWitness: evidence that a concrete Domain Profile refines the standard session theorem
concepts.causalOccurrence: bounded event sequence or partial order that actually occurs between declared Fact cuts
concepts.causalExperience: one or more Episodes used as evidence or learning material without being mistaken for reality
concepts.actionCoordinateMapping: Domain Profile mapping to Pursuit, Atlas, or Warrant semantics
concepts.actionResponsibilityGeometry: three-coordinate cross-domain responsibility model over the Fact-Episode Ontology
concepts.actionCoordinate: independently addressable direction, perspective, or bounded-authority coordinate
concepts.semanticIndependence: semantic distinguishability and traceability independent of physical component count
concepts.semanticComponentDistinguishability: counterfactual and fail-visible separation of ontology bindings and action coordinates even when physically co-located

kfd-8.label: KFD-8
kfd-8.title: Perspective must remain bound to admitted facts and declared loss

compatibility.rule: Before stable, this numbered draft may be refined with explicit lineage and synchronized projections; after stable, substantive change requires an explicit KFD-1 compatibility action.

atlasCoordinate.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may keep schemaVersion 1; semantic or required-field changes require a new interface version or contract.

concepts.atlas: independently addressable perspective coordinate bound to a perspective holder, declared vantage or decision purpose, admitted Fact cut, typed source authority, freshness conditions, omissions, conflicts, unknowns, and declared transformation loss

kfd-9.label: KFD-9
kfd-9.title: Continuing direction must outlive the actions that advance it

compatibility.rule: Before stable, this numbered draft may be refined with explicit lineage and synchronized projections; after stable, substantive change requires an explicit KFD-1 compatibility action.

concepts.pursuit: independently addressable intended change or maintained condition with continuing direction, progress relation, typed relations, lineage, and settlement semantics; Domain Profiles own terminal success conditions

kfd-10.label: KFD-10
kfd-10.title: Authority must remain explicit, bounded, and revocable

compatibility.rule: Before stable, this numbered draft may be refined with explicit lineage and synchronized projections; after stable, substantive change requires an explicit KFD-1 compatibility action.

concepts.warrant: independently addressable bounded authority with grantor, holder, authentic derivation, validity conditions, typed limits, attenuation, residual responsibility, and revocation

kfd-11.label: KFD-11
kfd-11.title: Consequential settlement must separate claim, assessment, decision, and admission

compatibility.rule: Before stable, the consequential-settlement procedure may be refined with explicit lineage; after stable, semantic, required-field, verification-meaning, or responsibility-boundary change requires a new interface version or an explicit KFD-1 compatibility action.

decisionAdmission.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may retain version 1; semantic, required-field, verification-meaning, Decision-authority, or Admission-result changes require a new interface version or contract.

adopterWitness.compatibilityRule: Changes to exact-Warrant, independent-Admission, retry, or failure-evidence semantics require a new interface version or contract.

qualificationReport.compatibilityRule: Qualification levels may not be fused or automatically escalated without a new interface version or contract.

activationRecord.compatibilityRule: Changes to pass, revise, reject, exact evidence, residual risk, or independent-decision semantics require a new interface version or contract.

concepts.claim: exact bounded proposition made by a declared participant against inspectable Fact and evidence cuts
concepts.assessment: purpose-bound revisable trust judgment over an exact Claim and checked evidence boundary
concepts.decision: authorized disposition of assessed Claims under an exact Warrant and policy
concepts.admission: independently recorded result of presenting a requested transition to the owning state authority

kfd-12.label: KFD-12
kfd-12.title: Software work must keep Initiative and Assignment distinct

compatibility.rule: Before stable, the software-domain lifecycle may be refined with explicit lineage; after stable, substantive change to Initiative, Assignment, or their lifecycle requires an explicit KFD-1 compatibility action.

adopterWitness.compatibilityRule: Changes to Initiative or Assignment responsibility, proposal and acceptance, exact coordinate bindings, or session round-trip semantics require a new interface version or contract.

qualificationReport.compatibilityRule: Qualification levels may not be fused or automatically escalated without a new interface version or contract.

activationRecord.compatibilityRule: Changes to pass, revise, reject, exact evidence, residual risk, or independent-decision semantics require a new interface version or contract.

concepts.softwareWorkResponsibilityLifecycle: software-domain separation of Initiative, Assignment, occurrence, Claim, Assessment, Decision, Admission, and continuation
concepts.initiative: independently addressable context for continuing coordinated software work without redefining Pursuit direction
concepts.assignment: independently addressable accepted responsibility that binds Pursuit, Atlas, Warrant, evidence, settlement, and lineage

kfd-13.label: KFD-13
kfd-13.title: Project settlement must bind authorities without absorbing them

compatibility.rule: Before stable, the software-project settlement procedure may be refined with explicit lineage; after stable, substantive change requires an explicit KFD-1 compatibility action.

adopterWitness.compatibilityRule: Changes to authority preservation, canonical-root, residual-risk, export verification, or successor-lineage semantics require a new interface version or contract.

qualificationReport.compatibilityRule: Qualification levels may not be fused or automatically escalated without a new interface version or contract.

activationRecord.compatibilityRule: Changes to pass, revise, reject, exact evidence, residual risk, or independent-decision semantics require a new interface version or contract.

concepts.projectCut: software-project settlement binding that preserves independently authoritative source, Atlas, Episode, policy, omission, and risk coordinates
